## What I do

- Quantitative trade policy analysis — tariff, non-tariff, and trade
  agreement impact assessment using firm- and product-level data
- Export strategy and market access diagnostics for firms and industry
  bodies
- Country and sector trade exposure assessments
- Expert commentary, briefings, and evidence submissions for policymakers
  and journalists

## Who I work with

Government trade and economics departments, international organisations,
industry associations, and research centres — including the Kyiv School of
Economics Foreign Trade Research Center (Trade+) and Aston Business School.

## How to engage

The fastest way to reach me is email: [shepotylo@gmail.com](mailto:shepotylo@gmail.com).

## Parliamentary evidence

- **[The UK's economic security](https://committees.parliament.uk/writtenevidence/139753/pdf/)**
  (Business and Trade Committee, ECO0009; with Karen Jackson).
  Argues that security assurances reduce uncertainty and encourage commerce,
  so aligning security and trade policy — as NATO membership and EU
  economic integration did — yields outsized benefits.
- **[Global Competitiveness and Trade in Services](https://committees.parliament.uk/writtenevidence/111050/html/)**
  (House of Lords Communications and Digital Committee, "A creative future";
  with Jun Du and co-authors). Evidence on UK creative-industry services
  exports and how Brexit affected them.

- **[UK-US trade negotiations](https://committees.parliament.uk/work/350/ukus-trade-negotiations/publications/written-evidence/)**
  (House of Commons International Trade Committee, 2020, UST0062; with Jun Du
  and Uzoamaka Nduka). Written evidence to the inquiry into the prospective
  UK-US trade agreement.
- **[The future UK-EU relationship on professional and business services](https://committees.parliament.uk/writtenevidence/40518/pdf/)**
  (House of Lords European Union Committee, October 2021; with Jun Du).
  Written evidence on UK services trade with the EU after Brexit.
- **[Written evidence to a parliamentary committee](https://committees.parliament.uk/writtenevidence/22434/pdf/)**
  (with Jun Du). Inquiry title to be confirmed.
- **[Written evidence to a parliamentary committee](https://committees.parliament.uk/writtenevidence/7961/default/)**
  (with Jun Du, Mustapha Douch and Uzoamaka Nduka). Inquiry title to be
  confirmed.
- **[Written evidence to a parliamentary committee](https://committees.parliament.uk/writtenevidence/122379/html/)**
  Inquiry title and co-authors to be confirmed.
